Desired Profile 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in Power BI Dashboard Development, Sales Analytics, MIS Reporting, and Business Intelligence. 
• Strong experience in transforming large datasets into interactive dashboards and actionable business insights. 
• Experience supporting Sales, Trade Marketing, Distribution, or FMCG business teams preferred. 
• 
Hands-on expertise in Power BI, Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools.Key Responsibilities 
• Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards for Sales, Distribution, Secondary Sales, Primary Sales, and KPI tracking. 
• Create automated dashboards for: 
• Sales Performance 
• Target vs Achievement 
• Territory Performance 
• ASM/RSM Productivity 
• Distributor Analysis 
• SKU-wise Sales Performance 
• Outlet Coverage and Growth Tracking 
• Develop data models, measures, and calculations using DAX. 
• Connect and integrate data from Excel, ERP, CRM, SAP, or other business systems. 
• Automate manual reporting processes through Power BI and Power Query. 
• Analyze sales trends and provide actionable insights to business stakeholders. 
• Prepare executive dashboards for leadership reviews. 
• Ensure data accuracy, validation, and governance. 
• 
Work closely with Sales, Finance, IT, and Business Heads to understand reporting requirements.Technical Skills (Mandatory) 
• Power BI (Expert Level) 
• Dashboard Development 
• Data Modeling 
• DAX 
• Power Query 
• Data Transformation 
• Row-Level Security 
• Publishing & Scheduling Reports 
• Advanced Excel 
• Pivot Tables 
• Power Query 
• Advanced Formulas 
• SQL Queries 
• Data Analytics & Visualization 
• 
KPI & Sales ReportingPreferred Skills 
• Experience in FMCG/Dairy Sales Analytics. 
• Exposure to SAP, CRM, Distributor Management Systems (DMS). 
• Knowledge of Tableau is an added advantage. 
• 
Power BI Certification preferred.Qualifications 
• Graduate in Commerce, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline. 
• Power BI Certification (Microsoft PL-300 preferred).
